title: Isolating a vibrating machine
caption: A 1500 rpm machine shakes at 25 Hz; its mounts resonate at 5 Hz, a frequency ratio of 5. Above r = √2 the mounts transmit less force than they receive; at r = 5 only 1/(r² − 1) = 0.042 (4.2%) gets through.
alt: Transmissibility against frequency ratio: a spike at 1, falling below 1 beyond the square root of 2, and down to about 0.04 at a ratio of 5.
description: Transmissibility (undamped) = 1 / |1 − r²|: it blows up at r = 1 (resonance) and equals 1 at r = √2.
